name: ElectrifiedMainline
title: Electrified Mainline
author: Bionic Assistant
description: Adds high-speed electrified railway infrastructure to Factorio. 25 kV nominal overhead line poles and high-speed electric locomotive visual prototype; 20 MW automatic reversible substation power bridge with read-only 061 priority diagnostics; real electric traction and storage planned. Fair power sharing across multiple isolated electrical networks.
